name: Camping 101: Fishing

angles.text: Astaia resides in Darnassus, making the night elf capital a primary destination for Alliance anglers looking to expand their campsite craft.
Camps require a proper campfire to establish, making basic culinary training an essential partner to an angler's outdoor shelter.

faq.answer: Astaia is located in Darnassus. Once an angler has demonstrated adequate proficiency in fishing, Astaia teaches them how to craft a decorative Fish Bowl for their campsite.
faq.q: Who teaches you how to craft camping items for fishing?

faq.answer: The Fish Bowl serves as a campsite fixture meant to bring comfort and joy to resting adventurers. A happy, well-rested camper fights with renewed vigor, directly benefiting outdoor expeditions.
faq.q: What purpose does a Fish Bowl serve at camp?

faq.answer: Camps cannot be pitched in the heart of settlements or town centers. To set up camp and place fixtures like a Fish Bowl, travelers must head out into the wilderness.
faq.q: Can you set up a camp inside Darnassus or other cities?

aliases: what do you need for a camp
faq.answer: No campsite is complete without a basic campfire. Travelers are advised to seek out a cooking trainer to learn how to kindle a fire before establishing their wilderness camp.
faq.q: What is required before setting up a camp?

aliases: when can i learn fish bowl
faq.answer: To learn the craft from Astaia, an adventurer must first demonstrate proficiency in the fishing profession.
faq.q: Do you need fishing skill to learn how to craft a Fish Bowl?

faq.answer: Setting up a camp offers outdoor travelers a place of rest and morale-boosting amenities, such as a crafted Fish Bowl, ensuring adventurers stay rested and capable during wilderness ventures.
faq.q: Why do adventurers set up camps in the wild?

sections.body: Anglers traveling through Kalimdor often find that their quiet hours at the water's edge can serve a greater purpose. In Darnassus, the craftswoman Astaia shows experienced fishermen how to turn their catches and skills into campsite fixtures, notably by fashioning a Fish Bowl to display at camp. This decorative piece provides a welcome touch of comfort and cheer for road-weary travelers.
sections.title: Comfort at the Campsite

sections.body: Establishing a proper wilderness refuge requires more than just fishing gear. Camps cannot be placed inside crowded city centers or urban districts, requiring adventurers to venture out under open skies. Furthermore, every camp requires a warm campfire at its foundation, prompting adventurers to visit local culinary trainers to master basic fire-making before settling down for the night.
sections.title: Wilderness Necessities

summary: Camping 101: Fishing introduces anglers to the art of wilderness comfort by teaching them to craft a decorative Fish Bowl for their campsite. Directed to Astaia in Darnassus, skilled fishermen learn that small touches of joy can bolster an adventurer's spirit and combat prowess out in the wilds.
